label: Действительно
description: A 10-sentence usage card for действительно (really, indeed) covering confirmation and emphasis.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Confirming emphasis. 'Действительно' means 'really' and reinforces the predicate 'вкусно', confirming the taste is genuinely good. It adds sincere conviction.
Strategic focus: Verifying a claim. 'Действительно' modifies 'знает', affirming that he truly knows. It carries a more formal tone than the casual 'правда'.
Strategic focus: Checking sincerity. Here 'действительно' questions whether the wish is genuine, meaning 'really'. It probes for a truthful answer.
Strategic focus: Agreement opener. As a sentence opener 'действительно' means 'indeed', confirming what was just said. It signals agreement before the remark.
Strategic focus: Emphasising negation. 'Действительно' strengthens 'не понимаю', meaning the confusion is genuine. It underlines sincerity even under negation.
Strategic focus: Reinforcing a description. 'Действительно' intensifies the adjective 'талантливый', affirming real talent. It lends weight to the praise.
Strategic focus: Genuine recommendation. 'Действительно' modifies 'стоит', confirming the film is truly worth watching. It boosts the strength of the advice.
Strategic focus: Confirming degree. 'Действительно' reinforces 'много', affirming that he genuinely works a lot. It validates the extent of the effort.
Strategic focus: Affirming reality. 'Действительно' modifies 'случилось', insisting the event really took place. It counters any doubt about the fact.
Strategic focus: Sincere feeling. 'Действительно' strengthens the predicate 'рад', stressing genuine gladness. It makes a warm greeting feel heartfelt.
